country_ref.description: A country tag or variable. Supported variables: $THIS (firing country), $PLAYER (player country).

name.description: Display name of the event, shown as the title in the event popup.

desc.description: Flavour text shown in the body of the event popup.

MTTH.description: Mean Time To Happen in days. Lower values fire more frequently.

conditions.description: All conditions must pass for this event to be eligible to fire. If omitted, the event is always eligible.

options.description: Player choices shown as buttons in the event popup. At least one option is required.

text.description: Button label shown to the player.

effects.description: Effects applied when the player selects this option. Shown in the button tooltip.

hidden_effects.description: Effects applied silently when the player selects this option. Not shown in the tooltip.

condition_has_global_flag.description: Passes if the named global flag is currently set.

condition_not_global_flag.description: Passes if the named global flag is NOT set.

condition_money_above.description: Passes if the firing country's money is strictly greater than value.

condition_money_below.description: Passes if the firing country's money is strictly less than value.

condition_stability_above.description: Passes if the firing country's stability is strictly greater than value.

condition_stability_below.description: Passes if the firing country's stability is strictly less than value.

condition_relations_above.description: Passes if source's opinion of target is strictly greater than value. source defaults to the firing country.

condition_relations_below.description: Passes if source's opinion of target is strictly less than value. source defaults to the firing country.

condition_NOT.description: Passes if ALL nested conditions fail (logical NOR). Typically used with a single child.

condition_OR.description: Passes if ANY nested condition passes.

condition_is_country.description: Passes if the firing country is the specified country.

effect_add_money.description: Adds or subtracts money from a country. Defaults to the firing country if target is omitted.

value.description: Amount of money to add. Use a negative number to subtract.

target.description: Country to receive the money. Defaults to the firing country.

effect_add_stability.description: Adds or subtracts stability from a country. Defaults to the firing country if target is omitted.

value.description: Amount of stability to add. Use a negative number to subtract.

target.description: Country to receive the stability change. Defaults to the firing country.

effect_set_global_flag.description: Sets a global flag that can be checked by event conditions.

value.description: Name of the global flag to set.
Name of the global flag to clear.

effect_message.description: Display-only. Shown in the option tooltip; not processed as a game effect.

value.description: Text to display in the tooltip.

effect_change_relations.description: Changes the opinion of source toward target by the given value. Note: this is one-directional; add a second effect for bilateral changes.

source.description: Country whose opinion is being changed.

target.description: Country that is the subject of the opinion change.

value.description: Amount to change the opinion by. Clamped to [-100, 100].
